_comment: Two ways to run this locally.
frontdesk-ui is the usual one: Vite serves the app from source with hot reload and
proxies /api, /widget and /w.js to the deployed Worker, so you are editing the UI
against REAL production data. Anything you save there saves for real.
frontdesk-local is the whole Worker on your machine, API included. It needs a database
to talk to, so start it yourself with
and this entry attaches the preview pane to it.
